bio: William Smith of Mastic belonged to the 'Tangier' Smith family of Long Island, not to the Bull Smiths, and is connected to John's family by marriage. He married Mary, daughter of Daniel Smith 2d and Hannah Brewster, and his sister Martha married Caleb Smith of Hauppauge. He is remembered as Judge William Smith: the family history records that Gen. John Smith, later a United States Senator, was 'the son of Judge William and Mary Smith', and that William 'suffered greatly from the British occupation of Long Island'.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 476, 491 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
